# Getting Started with the Labour Force Survey

## Three exercises to learn to work with  the LFS

### 1. Number of people in temporary work

A first exercise designed to help people get familiar with the QLFS - size, key variables, the main weight, the effect of using grossing weights on  estimates on the number of people  in temporary employment and its confidence interval.

### 2. Average weekly earnings of the employed

A follow up exercise using the QLFS but focusing on earnings - key earnings variables, the earnings weight, when not to use the earnings weight.

### 3. Proportion of people changing labour market participation between quarters  

Using the Labour Force Survey Two-Quarter Longitudinal Dataset - introduces the longitudinal datasets - the structure of the data, key variables for examining labour market flows, longitudinal weights and proportions
